title: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 17 WW3: The EU Vs. America

sense.text: We just watched a video: in the Dothan Police Department in Alabama, officers have been planting drugs and weapons on young black men since the 90s, and they were targeting black men with clean records, to sully their records. This is what the scriptures talk about. “Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee”: the throne of iniquity is America, the United States of America. Throne represents a kingdom, in case you didn’t know. The thee is the Most High. “Which frameth mischief by a law”: they create laws to destroy us. Why won’t CNN, MSNBC, ABC or NBC air this? None of them, not one, and that’s by design. They all understand the program; the problem is the majority of us don’t understand it.

“They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous”: they gather themselves together against the Israelites. “And condemn the innocent blood”: that’s what we just witnessed. This is why you can’t have a corrupt, immoral people trying to enforce law, justice and order; the two don’t mix, like oil and water. What can we do if we can’t take arms up, which we can’t, we ain’t got enough? The only thing we can do is turn to the Most High. The Most High is our power.

precepts.why: “Not by might”: that’s what I wanted to get to. When you hear things like that it infuriates me, because you know it’s the truth. But God comes back and says not by might, meaning we are not supposed to take up the limited arms we got against a nation of violence that was built upon violence. “Nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts”: the Most High has always given us the key. We have to use his words to overcome the situation that we’re in. Some of us will get locked up, some of us may even be put to death for his word, but we can’t be afraid, because there is a resurrection.

“Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad”: a dummy will get mad and do something dumb. It says a wise man; we’re the wise men. We’re supposed to organize and get our lives, our minds, our souls, our families and our communities together. “And a gift destroyeth the heart”: they will give Negroes big jobs, big positions, to stay hush. You mean Don Lemon don’t know about this? These famous black journalists don’t know nothing? You got to be kidding me.

sense.text: We’re going to talk about your favorite country and mine. “Flee out of the midst of Babylon”: Babylon is referring to the land of the north, meaning North America. “And deliver every man his soul”: it’s not saying pack your bags and head for the hills. This is a spiritual fleeing, not a physical one. “Be not cut off in her iniquity”: Babylon has established iniquities meant for our people to follow, such as Halloween, Thanksgiving, Fourth of July, Christmas, New Year’s, Valentine’s Day, Labor Day and President’s Day; every day is abortion day. Brother, Christmas is coming up and my wife said it’s for the children: you brothers that listen to the dumb sister that says that, shame on you. Not the righteous women, but dumb black and Latin women who tell you Christmas is for the children; that’s a lie, they love the white man. “He will render unto her a recompence”: recompence means judgment, payback. Write that down.

“Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand”: North America, the capital of Babylon. A lot of you third world country brothers hear about America on your little island and think the streets are paved with gold. That’s why Revelation calls America Babylon the great: it’s the greatest country on the planet earth. That’s why the comedic community ain’t leaving here; they talk about Africa, Africa, but ain’t none of them moving over there. “The nations have drunken of her wine”: her wine represents falsehood and lies; all the nations have followed North America’s falsehoods and lies. “Therefore the nations are mad”: meaning crazy. So when Israelites hear flee out of the midst of Babylon and say let’s run to another country: brothers and sisters, all the nations are under the influence of North America. Look at how the Saudi Arabian dresses in a three-piece suit and tie; you think that’s their custom? America does not say take my falsehood and my lies. They say take my democracy, take my religions, take my policies. You learn to substitute the words here for words that are common today.

“Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed”: Jeremiah sees in a vision the destruction of Babylon. The nations are mad, crazy and angry, and somehow, some shape or form, they are going to retaliate on this place.

“We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed”: there’s no healing for this place. “And let us go every one into his own country”: when this place is destroyed everybody is going to leave and go back to their own land.
“Come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God”: the word that we bring forth is not for all nations; it’s only for Zion, which means Israel.

“The Lord hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes”: this is a metaphor. Jeremiah is seeing Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar, but he is also making reference to the last Babylon, which is in the land of the north. That’s why I precepted it with Zechariah 2:6-7.

“Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon”: the standard in Babylon is the Holy Bible; that’s the standard we are commanded to set up. “Make the watch strong”: the watch is you brothers, and that’s why you can’t be in this truth a weakling, effeminate. Brother, I can’t come because my wife said no: you’re not strong; God can’t use you. The Most High puts some trials on you to see if you are going to put his word first.

“O thou that dwellest upon many waters”: Babylon has embassies and bases in every country; they are everywhere, just like ancient Babylon. Who controls the waters? America with his battleships. “Abundant in treasures”: some of you are fooled by CNN talking about the national debt. God says this is the richest country on the earth. You and I might be broke, but they robbed the wealth of nations, and they print money. They set their military bases overseas to take everybody’s treasures and bring them here. They set up the World Bank and the IMF in Washington DC; let any country get out of order and they press a button and freeze all their accounts, like there’s no buying or trading with Iran. “And the measure of thy covetousness”: so covetous they coveted the moon. They claimed it not for all races but for your friendly neighborhood white man, the United States of America, when they put that dusty flag up there. Now he’s sending satellites to Mars.

“Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers”: a caterpillar eats a tree from within. God is going to fill Babylon with people that will eat and destroy from within: your terrorists. They come from the other nations, because Babylon the great has stolen their treasures. They say we are coming over to your land, and we are going to kill you for taking what you took. That’s the bottom of verse 7: therefore the nations are mad.

precepts.why: Real quick, let’s see about Babylon. “Come forth, and flee from the land of the north”: what you want to highlight is the land of the north. “For I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven”: although we have spread abroad, he is specifying the land of the north. “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon”: Zion, the Israelites, particularly Judah, would dwell, meaning live, with the daughter of Babylon in the land of the north, meaning North America.

“If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink”: here the prophet Micah is comparing wine to falsehood and strong drink. So when we go back to Jeremiah 51:7, her wine represents falsehood and lies.

sense.text: “I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters”: when you look at the various commentaries, they will tell you the great whore is the Roman Catholic Church. Who is dwelling upon many waters, brothers? Babylon the great; not the Catholic church. The seven vials the angels had you read about in previous chapters, which lead up to the destruction.

“With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication”: automatically some of you might be thinking sexual immorality. That is the first meaning of fornication, but the country is not running around literally having sex with Saudi Arabia or Africa; it’s talking about spiritual fornication. Where are you going to run to, if the kings of the earth are committing spiritual fornication dealing with America’s philosophies? “And the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication”: we went through all this to show you what the wine of their fornication is: their spiritual fornication, their philosophies, their policies. All the people are drunk with it; now everybody believes that same sex is good, and if you speak against it people want to curse you out.

precepts.why: “O thou that dwellest upon many waters”: so who is dwelling upon many waters, brothers? Babylon. It’s telling you Babylon, not the Catholic church.
We just read it. “Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.”

This is going to explain the fornication that Revelation 17 is talking about. “For the devising of idols was the beginning of spiritual fornication, and the invention of them the corruption of life.” So you have something called spiritual fornication, which deals with idolatry and the corruption of life.

I remember the Gulf War, when America set their bases up in Iraq and the people said we don’t want your army men coming into the town, because the way y’all live is going to affect the way we are; y’all believe in homos and all that other stuff. And they were raping the women over there and all of that. “Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit”: vain deceit means lies. “After the tradition of men”: the main philosopher of men is the so-called white man; he is the one influencing everybody on the planet earth. “And not after Christ”: his philosophy has nothing to do with Christ. You might have thought the Constitution was based upon the Bible; it’s not. Freedom of speech and freedom of religion are not God ordained. We know the Most High used that to allow us to bring the truth out, but it is not of God.

Another word for wine and for fornication. This is talking about Antiochus Epiphanes, when he tried to hellenize everybody; hellenize is another word for assimilate. “And through his policy”: that is the word. In America today the political agendas are called their policies, whether economic, political, financial or socioeconomic. What Antiochus Epiphanes did, America is following suit today.

This goes in more detail on what Antiochus Epiphanes and the Greeks did to the nations. “That all should be one people”: does this sound familiar? America says we should all be one people. “And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king.” “Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion”: that religion is still his politics. They try to separate church and state, but the two always go hand in hand. Democracy, with unification as one people, is the same as Christianity: John 3:16, for God so loved the world, In God we trust. It’s the same ideology, the same policy.

About the Romans; the Greeks and Romans are the same people. “And that by their policy and patience they had conquered all the place, though it were very far from them”: they infiltrated and took over over time. That’s the US embassies; they spread their policies everywhere without being in the country, the same way the Romans set up outposts.

I want y’all to see the devil in full power. “How they destroyed and brought under their dominion all other kingdoms and isles that at any time resisted them”: doesn’t this sound like America? Anybody that resists America, they will bring them down. “All that heard of their name were afraid of them”: are people afraid of America? You better believe it. “Whom they would help to a kingdom, those reign; and whom again they would, they displace”: in Haiti they put Aristide in power, then when Aristide said I don’t want democracy they kidnapped him in the middle of the night and exiled him. Saddam Hussein was America’s man; he worked for the CIA, and Osama Bin Laden. “A senate house”: America has the Senate. “They committed their government to one man every year”: in America it’s every four years, called the president. America is following the same pattern as the Greeks and the Romans; this is another reason they took the Apocrypha from the Bible. If you leave it in, people will see them as they are. Another speaker in the class points out that it is the senate that sets the man up, not your public vote: “to the end they might be well ordered,” they watched that man grow and said this is our guy.

sense.text: “I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast”: the word scarlet just means red; a red beast. Why is it called a scarlet coloured beast? This beast represents man; what man? A red man: Esau. The majority of the Book of Revelation is a metaphor; if you’ve never read Genesis all the way up, you’ll be lost in Revelation. If color doesn’t matter, why would God put red there? To give us a guideline, because there is another red mentioned in Genesis 25:25. White people say I’m olive complexion; olives come in three colors, black, brown and green, so which one are they? None of them. “Having seven heads and ten horns”: the seven heads are the seven great Edomite empires, in order: Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Great Britain. Christians name popes; I couldn’t stop laughing. The ten horns are the EU, also known as the common markets. Write this down: Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Denmark, Ireland, United Kingdom and Greece. There are more now, but those are the first main ones, from 1957 to 1981.

precepts.why: “And behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns”: the same beast.
When you talk to the Jehovah’s Witnesses, they’ll say, well brother, it says beast. “That they might see that they themselves are beasts.”

“And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau”: Esau, which in the Hebrew means wasted away. Esau is red. Jacob’s color is not mentioned, because Jacob looked like everybody else from the time of Adam.

“For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth”: so the last kingdom before the Israelites rule would be Esau. Don’t let nobody tell you Japheth; you got these dumb Israelites saying Japheth is ruling. If it’s Japheth, we got another thousand years. Stop listening to these dumb Israelites. The prophecies are all lined up, pointing straight to this man. Where does it say Japheth is the last kingdom on earth ruling? Where does it say Japheth would go to the moon? It don’t say that.

Shem, Ham and Japheth descend from Genesis 2:7. “And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground”: in case you didn’t know it, brothers, the dust of the ground is different shades of brown, from a very dark brown to a light brown. The next change in color comes in Genesis 25:25, way after Shem, Ham and Japheth. There’s only red people and brown people.

Who is this woman? “And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth”: the great city is still talking about Babylon the great. The Catholic church is not ruling over the kings of the earth; don’t let these dumb Christians fool you. That comes from the Protestants against the Catholics, the war white men had with themselves.

sense.text: “And decked with gold and precious stones and pearls”: where did she get these items? A brother in the class answers: through slavery of the Israelites, and by robbing the other nations. All that goes together. Why did the Most High have this woman decked with stones and pearls? If you’ve ever flown in an airplane over America at night, it looks like pearls and diamonds scattered down there: the lights stay on all night, while in some third world countries they cut the electricity off at a certain time of night. “Having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication”: that’s her policies. Abominations, plural; it’s not one thing. How do you think America is able to deal with all the kings of the earth? They have to appease them in some shape, form or fashion, things they allow economically or politically.

precepts.why: I’m going to show you that this woman, the great city which reigneth over all the kings of the earth, is America. 2 Esdras 11:39 down begins with Rome and extends to America; America is an extension of ancient Rome. That’s why we went through Maccabees: everything Greece and Rome did with their senate and one leader, America followed. “Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts”: the four beasts were prophesied in Daniel 7; Daniel never described the fourth beast. “And over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression”: I know you like to think America is a Christian society; God says they rule with much wicked oppression. “And so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit”: you thought they got Central, South and North America through voting; the slaves were voted to come over here. Wherever you go, America is there. “Thou hast afflicted the meek, thou hast hurt the peaceable”: that’s us. “Thou hast loved liars”: their allies. “His abominations are fulfilled”: remember this woman was full of abominations. “Nor thy malicious heads, nor thy hurtful claws, nor all thy vain body”: this is America and her allies, France, Germany, Russia; all of them, every last one. “That all the earth may be refreshed”: God said if you want world peace, the eagle must go. That’s too big of a pill for people to swallow; they’ll say you’re a racist, but I’m reading the Bible. Another speaker in the class adds that verse 44 parallels Jeremiah 51:13, ‘thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness’: the Most High had enough; it’s time to judge. And “thou hast loved liars” goes back to the news report, twenty years they let that go on, and to Columbus Day, Abraham Lincoln, Washington, Thanksgiving and Mount Rushmore: that’s loving the liars.

To prove it: “The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel”: that’s Daniel 7, the fourth kingdom. Daniel never described what it looked like; Ezra says it’s an eagle. What is the symbol of America? The eagle. What was the symbol of Rome? The eagle.

sense.text: “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT”: why is it a mystery? Because nobody would ever believe that the greatest evil on earth is this country right here. The same enemy that feeds us, clothes us and educates us is the serpent. Our people are quick to say who’s Babylon, Iraq? Ain’t nobody in Iraq; Iraq is trying to get over here. It don’t say Babylon the worst; it says Babylon the great. Whatever you want, riches, fame and fortune, you can get it here. “THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS”: some Bibles have a note that says fornications, which is what we read in Wisdom of Solomon 14 about spiritual fornication. That ties in with the church religious systems, but it’s really going with their political system first and foremost, because they are sent out to manipulate the nations. Historically, before America became America, when they were conquering the Caribbean islands and Central, South and North America, their first line was the Jesuit priests. The word Jesuit is Latin; it means crafty ones. Those guys don’t just sit and read scripture; they learned politics, geography, language and military strategy, and they were the eyes and ears for the countries that sent them. Look up Ignatius of Loyola. Now when they get caught over in Afghanistan they say oh, we were just tourists; no, these are CIA and FBI agents.

precepts.why: I’m going to show you why it’s a mystery. “And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle”: a great escape. “That she might fly into the wilderness, into her place”: we came to America. “Where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent”: 350 years. The Bible says the serpent is nourishing us.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger”: if you want food you got to serve your enemies, and your enemy in this verse is the serpent in Revelation 12 that’s nourishing us. “And in want of all things”: education, burial, babies born, religion; whatever you want you got to get from your enemy. Christians start reading in Matthew and get to Revelation dumb as hell and lost. If they had just read Deuteronomy about Israel being nourished by their enemy, when they get to Revelation and it says nourished by the serpent, it’s the same exact thing.

Now I want to prove further that Esau is Babylon. “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom”: let’s see what they call Edom. “O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed”: God is calling Edom the daughter of Babylon. Edom, that’s the so-called Caucasian, represents Babylon.

We read it at the beginning of the lesson. Once you got Edom, the next clue is the land of the north: write this down, North America. “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon”: Babylon would be the land of the north, and Judah and Israel would dwell with her.

sense.text: “And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus”: somebody might say wait a minute, the martyrs of Jesus were killed by Rome. We got a baby names book by Judith, a Rhodes scholar, and under Esau it says that according to the commentaries on Hebrew scripture Esau is considered the forefather of the Roman Empire. So the Roman Empire is Esau. Who are the saints? Israel, Psalms 148:14. The martyrs of Jesus were killed by the Romans in Jerusalem in 70 AD, and even before that, in Acts 12. It’s one race killing Israelites: Esau. And the saints didn’t stop on that side of the world. In the Indian Wars there was Geronimo; Geronimo is Jeremiah, the same name with the letters changed. The seers and shamans were prophets, but the white man changed those words to make them more scary. Those are the saints they were killing: Israelites who knew they were Israel. James Adair said the Indians he witnessed were celebrating Israelite high holy days and saying Hebrew words. “And when I saw her”: the woman is the white man; the woman is Babylon.

“I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns”: the angel says I’m going to tell you about that woman, and about that great red dragon too.

“The beast that thou sawest was, and is not”: it was in his vision, but is not currently in existence. “And shall ascend out of the bottomless pit”: which is a region of Europe. “And go into perdition”: perdition means destruction; this beast is meant to be destroyed. “And yet is”: it’s a race of people; Esau, who at this time was Rome. Remember in Esdras the last beast starts off as Rome and goes to America.
“The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth”: Christians run around naming popes; this ain’t talking about popes, this is talking about the seven great empires of Esau.

“And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is”: the one that is, at that time, was Rome. John wrote this around 96 AD, the first century, so find the first-century names of these empires. Greece was called Achaia, A-C-H-A-I-A; France was called Gaul, G-A-U-L, or Aquitania; Spain was called Hispania; Germany was called Magna Germania; and Russia was called Scythia. Write that down. When you Google these things they take you to around 1200 AD, the Ostrogoths, the Visigoths, the Franks; those are not the names from the first century. So the five that fell are Greece, France, Spain, Germany and Russia, and the one that is, is Rome. “And the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space”: Great Britain. Not America; Great Britain must come and rule for a short space.

“Even he is the eighth, and is of the seven”: the seventh was Great Britain, so who came out of Great Britain? America, the War of Independence, 1776. “And goeth into perdition”: destruction. Did they have weapons that could bring on this destruction during the time of Britain or the times before? It’s showing you how all the prophecies come together: the red man is the one ruling, and he is the one that is going to fight against Christ.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings”: the ten common markets, also called NATO, the EU, the European Union. It don’t say Arab Union. What color is this beast, brothers? Red. These Christian commentaries will say China, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Egypt; no, this is from one race of people. “Which have received no kingdom as yet”: no power, no authority as yet. “But receive power as kings one hour with the beast”: one hour with the Lord, worked out with 2 Peter 3:8, comes to about 41 years. The European Economic Community was created by the Treaty of Rome of 1957, and its six founding members were Belgium, France, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands and West Germany. The European Coal and Steel Community, from the Treaty of Paris in 1951, was proposed by the French foreign minister Robert Schuman; that’s a French Amalekite. Us white folks will all share in this wisdom, they said. Coal and steel are the two main elements used for weapons: tanks, guns, arsenal. Then the European Atomic Energy Community shared nuclear power among its member states. Remember they dropped a bomb on Japan, and they left Japan out of this. Ireland, Denmark and the United Kingdom joined in 1973, and Greece in 1981. Once they shared economics, coal and steel, and atomic energy, that’s when they got their power: literal atomic power and economic power, for one hour, which is 41 years. Don’t ask me if it started in 1957.

“These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast”: they would support America, Babylon, and we’re living in that right now. They use all that knowledge of science and economic trade to support America.

precepts.why: I was meditating on this one hour and had to call up Brother Solomon, a mathematician. “That one day is with the Lord as a thousand years”: how many hours is in a day? 24. Divide a thousand years by 24 and you get 41 point something; 41 years and some months. Write that down. Don’t write me no email saying I’m lost; I’mma hit delete.

sense.text: “These shall make war with the Lamb”: who is going to make war with the Lamb? Esau is too broad; break it down more. People keep saying the Arabs or Russia are the ones going to fight Christ. I’m not saying they won’t be in the midst of it, but the main ones that are going to fight against Christ are the EU. “And they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful”: the angels.
“The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.”

“And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore”: who’s the whore, brothers? America. The European Union shall hate America. “And shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” We don’t see it, because everything looks peaceful; they are working together. But pay attention to the news: Greece is upset about the euro failing, and the economy is faltering in Greece. Write this down: Ezekiel 38 is not talking about World War III; it goes with Revelation 20:8, a thousand years after the reign of Christ. The next chapter, chapter 18, explains what happens when the European Union turns on America.
“For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will”: God is going to use the European Union to destroy this place. He is going to put in their minds, destroy Babylon.

precepts.why: There was a common misconception when we came into the truth: it was taught that the ambassador among the heathen was Gamal Abdel Nasser, who said let’s fight against Israel and was beaten in the Six Day War. That is not and cannot be what Obadiah is talking about, because it is not talking about the land of Israel. “Thou art greatly despised”: they are greatly despised. “Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock”: that is where the term Caucasian comes from, the clefts of the rocks of Georgia in Russia. Don’t say they always lived there; Esau lived originally in mount Seir, S-E-I-R. Write that down. They were the first dukes; they were wealthy. “Whose habitation is high”: that’s why they like skyscrapers. “Who shall bring me down to the ground?”: to ask who can conquer me, you got to have power. “Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle”: it wasn’t the land of Israel, which came in 1948; it’s America. “And though thou set thy nest among the stars”: did Israel set their nest among the stars? No, it’s America. “Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle”: rise up against Edom, America.

Does that mean nobody else is going to fight in the third world war but the EU? No. Yes, other nations will be there, the Arabs will be there, but the main major nations fighting will be the ten horns, the European Union. They are the power; they did not share nuclear technology with all these other nations. North Korea is still trying to make a bomb that can reach over here. “And he shall come to the astonishment of them that dwell on the earth”: that’s talking about Christ, the second coming. “Then shall my Son be declared”: that’s Jesus the Christ; in Hebrew, Yahawashi. “Every man shall in their own land leave the battle they have one against another”: everybody is going to stop fighting each other. “But he shall stand upon the top of the mount Sion”: Zion shall be showed to all men.

Chapter 18 explains what happens when the European Union turns on America. “Therefore shall her plagues come in one day”: that goes back with chapter 17 verse 16. “And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her”: I want you to understand this crystal clear: the merchants of the earth are not dealing with the Vatican; these dumb Christians, and some of y’all listening to them. This is talking about the United States of America, the place where the merchants of the earth are buying and selling. “For no man buyeth their merchandise any more”: that goes back to chapter 13, where if you didn’t have the mark of the beast you could not buy or sell. You got these dumb Israelites saying I just saw Alex Jones say this, or Herbert W. Armstrong; stop it.

Chapters 17, 18 and 19 go together, in order. “And he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True”: “And his name is called The Word of God”. “And he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God”: he is going to do a lot of stomping and killing. “And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies”: remember the beast had seven heads and ten horns. “And with him the false prophet”: the false prophet is making reference to the Catholic church, but I don’t like wording it like that; it’s Christianity. They isolate the Catholic church and then say Baptist is okay, Jehovah’s Witness is okay; no, it’s all one thing. In Revelation 13 the false prophet is the image of the beast, the religious Christian system; all those religions got Caesar in them. “That wrought miracles before him”: is it talking about my arm is healed in the name of Jesus? No. A brother in the class answers: when they dropped the bomb on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, 1945. Write that down. Your job, brothers, is to make the Bible real to our people. For centuries this demonic white man has made the Bible a fairy tale, like Santa Claus. The Bible is the realest thing on earth. “Them that had received the mark of the beast”: the mark of the beast is going into their policies. Esau is trying to make a computer chip, but that ain’t what this is talking about. The nations are following America’s policy, and whoever does not follow it cannot buy or sell: they shut it down through the IMF and put sanctions and embargoes on them. The chip comes from Herbert W. Armstrong, Jack Van Impe and Alex Jones.

I will prove to y’all that the Romans did the exact same thing: no buying or selling, no business interaction with them when they don’t cooperate. “Neither shall they give any thing unto them that make war upon them, or aid them with victuals, weapons, money, or ships”: no food, no weapons, no money, and ships goes into exporting and importing. “According to these articles”: another word for policies. America sets up articles; you read that word all through the newspaper. During this time we were trying to make an agreement with Rome, which they broke; that’s what 70 AD was all about. Now show me the chip in Maccabees.

sense.text: “And the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication”: the wine of her fornication is the same mark they are taking on, her policies. From beginning to end it’s the same thing. It ain’t talking about a chip in your hand; it’s talking about the abominations America puts out there, and the people support the policies.

This goes with the mark of the beast we brought out early on. “Full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication”: these are the policies, the philosophies, the religion that America pushes. The eugenics tree shows some of these abominations that work against our people: anatomy, biology, genetics, physiology, psychology, mental testing, anthropology, ethnology, geography, law, statistics, politics, economics, sociology, education, religion, psychiatry, surgery, medicine. The mark of the beast ain’t talking about us Negroes buying and selling; we are out of the equation. It’s talking about the nations, the merchants of the earth, buying and trading.

precepts.why: In case you’re still confused. “The merchandise of gold, and silver”: let me tell you, that little gold and silver y’all got ain’t the real gold and real silver; you got Negro gold and Negro silver. “And precious stones”: that cubic zirconia. These are the things they were buying and selling. “And slaves, and souls of men”: so Mr. Negro and Latino, you’re the slave; you’re the souls of men being bought and sold. Our people are simple as hell.
